details:
Summary:

This issue is specific to the MAIN Worlds menu (the large central menu panel). The smaller side World panel does NOT have this problem.

In the main Worlds menu, the configured sort order (set at the top-right, e.g. "Active") is only applied automatically to the FIRST favorite world list I open. When I switch to a different favorite world list (from the list of favorite world lists shown along the left edge of the main Worlds panel — e.g. "List A", "List B"), the newly opened list is NOT re-sorted by the configured order. It shows in default order, and I have to manually re-apply the sort order every time.

For comparison, the separate side World panel (docked beside the main menu) works correctly: switching world categories there applies the configured sort order immediately. So the problem is isolated to the main Worlds menu.

Platform:

- PC Desktop: reproduces

- PC VR: reproduces

(Both modes, same behavior)

Steps to reproduce:

1. Open the Main Menu and go to the Worlds section (central panel)

2. Make sure a sort order is set (top-right, e.g. "Active")

3. Select favorite world list "A" from the favorite list selector → it IS correctly sorted by the chosen order

4. Switch to a different favorite world list "B"

5. List "B" is NOT sorted by the configured order (shows default order)

Expected result:

In the main Worlds menu, the configured sort order should auto-apply to every favorite world list, regardless of which one is selected (same as the side World panel already does).

Actual result:

Only the first favorite list opened is auto-sorted. Switching to other favorite lists shows them in default order until the sort order is manually re-applied.

Frequency: Always (100%)
title: In the main Worlds menu, the configured sort order only auto-applies to the first favorite world list opened — switching to other favorite lists does not re-sort them
